scope: Registered exploratory native experiment; sanitized documentation, not the complete private executable protocol.
hypothesis: Study-coherent mild affine augmentation changes fixed final-epoch native image ranking relative to plain full-retention BCE from exactly shared initial states; zero-update ranking is a secondary descriptive reference.
panel_interpretation: Exposed or exposure-unknown soft report-label proxy. Previously inspected 128 studies are included; report overlap unknown and patient independence unproven.
held_order: Frozen lexicographic study order before training or held-target numeric conversion; actual IDs withheld.
report_targets: Five-source mean soft report targets, selected fit subset only during training.
gold_target_boundary: Registered execution excludes official Gold target-value tables. The observed partial log does not independently audit every future data read.
initialization: Two exactly shared original initialized tensor states per arm; four training networks total. Private checkpoint tensors and identity are withheld.

training.precision: FP16 native autocast with FP32 loss, GradScaler initial256. Any skipped/nonfinite update invalidates fixed exposure; HOLD preserves partial artifacts.

training_optimizer: Independent AdamW per network, cosine learning rate 1e-5 to 1e-6.
image_order: Float raw intensity [0,1], optional coherent affine, then ImageNet normalization.
dropout: Matched per-device dropout seed; heuristic native CUDA kernels are not claimed deterministic.
augmentation_rng: Separate study-key/epoch-derived PCG64 stream; no global training RNG consumption.
predictions: All predictions unaugmented; final epoch 4 only, no EMA/checkpoint/weight/epoch/LR selection.
first_production_batch_gate: Actual update 1, no extra optimizer step or reset: matching ordered input/window/raw/target hashes across arms, all four finite nonzero gradients, positive parameter deltas, AdamW step 1 and no scaler skip. Partial log events are not the full gate receipt.
actual_update_contract: Exactly 3488 AdamW steps per network; skipped, nonfinite or incomplete schedules remain HOLD and preserve partial artifacts.
prediction_target_boundary: Both complete fit seals and all three ordered 862-by-12 prediction files (plain, affine, zero-update), with schema/order/file hashes, before any held-target numeric conversion. Recheck disjointness and prediction hashes before target access.
target_fixture: Private ordered soft-target fixture; no fixture values or study identities published.
primary_metric: mild_affine_bce minus plain_bce macro report-proxy AUC over fixed all12 findings

statistics.sampling_unit: Whole study; identical resampling weights across all 12 findings and 3 prediction arms.
statistics.rejection: Reject entire draw if any finding loses either class; disclose rejected draws and never change the macro denominator.
statistics.interval: Pointwise conditional percentile intervals with NumPy linear quantiles; descriptive, not simultaneous or confirmatory.

checkpoint_preservation: All completed epoch checkpoints and receipts preserved; partial artifacts ineligible for submission or promotion.
